summary:
諾斯洛普格魯曼最新季度財報優於預期，受惠於國防需求增長，營收穩健上升。
• 每股盈餘達 7.68 美元，顯著高於預期
• 營收達到 108.8 億美元，年增率 5.07%
• 國防合規需求與軍事支出持續提供穩定現金流
• 本益比維持在 16.51，評價具相對防禦性
ai_view:
觀點：營收與獲利雙雙優於預期展現國防產業的基本面韌性。短中期來看，地緣政治緊張帶動的國防預算增長有利於訂單能見度，對股價具正向支撐。後續應追蹤國防合約執行效率、供應鏈成本控制以及自由現金流表現。

需留意：全球供應鏈瓶頸與勞動力短缺可能推高生產成本；大型國防專案面臨潛在的成本超支與進度延誤風險

summary_en:
Northrop Grumman reported stronger-than-expected quarterly earnings driven by robust defense demand and steady revenue growth.
• EPS of $7.68 significantly beat consensus estimates.
• Revenue reached $10.88 billion, representing a 5.07% YoY increase.
• Continued strong defense demand and military spending provided stable cash flows.
• Trailing P/E ratio stood at 16.51, offering defensive valuation characteristics.

ai_view_en:
View: Better-than-expected revenue and earnings demonstrate the fundamental resilience of the defense sector. In the near to mid-term, sustained defense budget increases driven by geopolitical tensions support order visibility and provide positive sentiment for the stock. Key metrics to track include defense contract execution efficiency, supply chain cost control, and free cash flow generation.

Watch：Global supply chain bottlenecks and labor shortages could drive up production costs.; Large-scale defense programs face potential risks of cost overruns and schedule delays.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：每股盈餘 7.68 美元高於市場預期的 6.82 美元，優於幅度達 12.66%。
